question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**practical**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The blank No. 5 in the passage requires a word that aligns with the context of forest vulnerability to fires.
 
• The word '**practical**' fits well in this context as it reflects the reasoning regarding the vulnerability of forests.
 
• Other options such as '**neutral**', '**competent**', and '**harmless**' do not align with the given context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Neutral: "Neutral" means impartial or not aligned with any side, which does not fit the context of forest vulnerability.
 
• Competent: "Competent" means having the ability or skill to do something, which does not relate to vulnerability.
 
• Harmless: "Harmless" means not causing any damage, which contradicts the idea of vulnerability to fire.
